verdict.rationale: Xero exposes a full REST API, OpenAPI spec, and SDKs (xero-node) plus 'Custom Connections' for machine-to-machine (M2M) integrations to a single org, which enables scripted/headless automation without a UI. However, there is no documented CLI, no explicit CI/CD examples, and no headless-mode guidance beyond generic API/SDK access. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless usage docs or examples, official CLI tool, and evidence of automated pipelines running against Xero.
